analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간 횡보 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이고 있다. 그러나 SMA200 대비 -37.07%로 여전히 큰 괴리를 보이며, 주봉 RSI 37.9, 주봉 MACD 히스토그램 -7857.1864로 약세 구간이다. ADX 30.5로 추세는 뚜렷하나 -DI가 +DI보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력이 잔존한다. 5일 연속 음봉 마감으로 매수 진입은 이르다.
analysis.reasonEn: Wait-and-see stance maintained for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone, with MACD histogram showing improvement. However, a significant -37.07% gap persists against SMA200. Weekly RSI at 37.9 and weekly MACD histogram at -7857.1864 indicate a bearish phase. ADX at 30.5 suggests a clear trend, but -DI remains above +DI, indicating residual downward pressure. Five consecutive daily closes in the red suggest it's too early for a buy entry.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100/200 (123,517 KRW/112,852 KRW): assessing mid-to-long-term trend weakness.
· 52-week position (15.5%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.4→38.7) + exiting oversold → entering neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2825.4509→543.9786) + improving → bottoming signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 48,595 KRW) + interpreting band width at 82.45% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (68,045 KRW) + basis (Higher Low formation based on 5-day low of 65,115 KRW).
· Swing resistance level (80,380 KRW) + expectation of trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + interpreting recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.92x vs 5-day average) + normal confidence level for price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + buy entry contingent on confirmation of 80,380 KRW breakout.
